<!-- hirsch-207-208-209-verification-20260912-b7a832e -->
Submission checkpoint for #207/#208/#209. The [near-geodesic occurrence budget](p2m:theorem/79bdd301-35e1-4cdb-a6ed-eb49b00e5c3c) and [exact proof](p2m:solution/1ede1000-2a0d-4d98-8736-1a828626eb2f) are Proved/ACCEPTED. For a walk within q of graph distance, repeated selected occurrences remain separately charged and the explicit pointwise budgets give sum(delta)+r*s <= r*e+(q+3)*s. This is resource accounting, not an arbitrary carrier distance bound.

The [additive-spill route theorem](p2m:theorem/32dbbfe9-bd4c-4685-8df6-7a4403175ef4) and [exact proof](p2m:solution/2a2dd9bd-9ee5-43fa-bc04-def26a5a2a98) are published/submitted, but proof verification is still PENDING as of 2026-09-13 00:03 UTC. No platform acceptance is claimed yet. The [finite repair definition](p2m:definition/be8f4ff8-23bd-4894-a523-ab6271d326f0) explicitly requires actual leaf routes, decreasing dimension tags, nonincreasing child excess, sibling sum at most e+b, and leaf cost at most C*e. The conclusion is an actual route with cost at most C*e+(1+b*C)*h*(e-b). Existence of such a geometrically valid tree for arbitrary carriers remains open.

All three #207 modules and all six #208 modules compile locally and in the final hosted gates; their 13 and 20 required declarations pass transitive standard-axiom audits. The exact regression suites pass after elaboration repairs. #208's complete infinite cyclic fixed-slack obstruction and adaptive block-slide construction remain mathematical-note results with exact finite checks: the transport/kernel components are Lean-verified, but the complete infinite argument is not claimed as a platform-accepted theorem. The obstruction concerns the specified first-original-edge/available-facet repair family, not every radial cap or a diameter lower bound.

The already merged #209 [target-tight basis theorem](p2m:theorem/e46935cf-6286-4874-a742-01cc62269b2d) and [proof](p2m:solution/63c8d2b9-2c24-4c59-9c3a-6769a095f63e) were reconfirmed without resubmission. Its larger conditional mixed-carrier route assemblies have separate local/hosted verification.

[PR #207](https://github.com/jjoshua2/prove2me-work/pull/207), [PR #208](https://github.com/jjoshua2/prove2me-work/pull/208), and [PR #209](https://github.com/jjoshua2/prove2me-work/pull/209) preserve the exact sources, proofs and receipts. The [common-face leaf](p2m:theorem/87a8b4f4-8b58-4340-8cb9-5fd1b548d01e) and Polynomial Hirsch remain Open. The next target is an input-dependent, possibly long but cheap portal selection controlling actual sibling excess, or a separate route bound for the remaining high-dimensional carriers. No cosmetic root dependency was added.
